metadata.case_name: LEE WAI MAN v. CHAN CHE MING AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: soft tissue injury of neck / neck sprain
source: Drs Fu and Lam agreed that the Plaintiff suffered a soft tissue injury of neck which had largely recovered.
The provisional diagnoses were ... neck sprain.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of cervical spine, unspecified

injuries.description: left acromio-clavicular ligament injury / left shoulder contusion
source: The provisional diagnoses were left peroneal nerve palsy, left knee medial collateral ligament sprain, left acromio-clavicular ligament injury and neck sprain.
The impression was one of "left shoulder contusion; left peroneal nerve injury �96 improving trend".
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of acromioclavicular joint

injuries.description: left knee medial collateral ligament sprain
source: Left knee examination revealed tenderness over left medial proximal tibia, and pain while performing valgus stress test.
The provisional diagnoses were left peroneal nerve palsy, left knee medial collateral ligament sprain, left acromio-clavicular ligament injury and neck sprain.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of medial collateral ligament of knee, excluding rupture

injuries.description: left peroneal nerve palsy (complete or incompletion division of nerve) / soft tissue injury of leg with peroneal nerve palsy
injuries.body_part: left lower leg / peroneal nerve distribution
source: In respect of the lower limbs, Drs Fu and Lam agreed that the Plaintiff had soft tissue injury of leg with left peroneal nerve palsy (complete or incompletion division of nerve) due to the Accident.
Nerve conduction test was done on 15th November 2007 and confirmed diagnosis of left peroneal nerve palsy.
The impression was one of "left shoulder contusion; left peroneal nerve injury �96 improving trend".
injuries.icd_description: Injury of peroneal nerve at lower leg level

manifestations.description: reduced range of left shoulder movement with pain
intermittent left ankle and left leg pain
intermittent numbness in left ankle and left leg
left ankle and big toe dorsiflexion power decreased (4-/5)
positive Tinel sign over anterolateral aspect of left leg, distal to fibula head
decreased sensation along left peroneal nerve distribution
left shoulder abduction 90� and reduced internal rotation
decreased range of motion in all directions of cervical spine

treatments_received: accident and emergency treatment at Prince of Wales Hospital
admission to Prince of Wales Hospital orthopaedics unit for neurology assessment

losses.description: Reduced efficiency at work; should take some rest after long period of walking; cannot lift more than 20kg; difficulty performing manual delivery duties
Problem with long periods of walking; needs rest after one hour of walking; decreased steadiness
Lower leg and ankle strength decreased about 50%
